An [inline link](https://example.com/page), one with a
[title](https://example.com "The Title"), and one whose
[**text** has `styles`](https://example.com/styled).

Autolinks: <https://example.com/auto>, <mailto:someone@example.com>,
<someone@example.com>, and bare ones: https://example.com/bare?q=1,
www.example.org/path, someone@example.net.

A link that shows its own address: [https://example.com](https://example.com).

An empty link [](https://example.com/empty) and brackets [that are not a link].

[ref]: https://example.com/reference "Reference Title"

A [reference link][ref], a collapsed one [ref][], a shortcut [ref],
and one with no definition [nowhere][none].
